|--------------|---------|-------|--------|------------|--------------|-------------|--------------|-------|
| Publisher    | Prompts | Calls | Tokens |      Input | Cached input | Cache write |       Output | CCost |
|--------------|---------|-------|--------|------------|--------------|-------------|--------------|-------|

* Tokens: known Input / Cached input / Cache write / Output volume, including reasoning in Output; K/M/B are rounded display only. ? marks incomplete telemetry;
  N/A means no known categories.
* Input / Cached input / Cache write / Output: Token Mix % of the model/publisher's token volume (Output includes reasoning) and its CCost.
* CCost: reference token valuation priced per request, not actual billing; ? marks partial pricing.
* Prompts: unique user prompts where the model contributed usage; one prompt can count on several rows.
* Calls: model requests attributed to the model, including tool-loop, subagent and compaction requests.

* History includes OpenCode usage data that is still available; deleted or pruned history is not reconstructed.
* Historical publisher shares use pooled shown requests, not the 100-slot comparison prior. Prompts are distinct within each model/publisher; mixed prompts can
  appear in several rows, so row prompt counts are not additive. Unknown / unverified is not an account provider.
